name: Qianxi Feng
summary: Qianxi Feng ( 千禧风 ) refers to the most prevalent fashion styles in China during the 2000s.
description: Qianxi Feng ( 千禧风 ) refers to the most prevalent fashion styles in China during the 2000s. It blended international trends with local aesthetics. Rooted in casual comfort, they expressed individuality through bold colors, tailoring and styling. Fashion in this era not only reflected how China aligned itself with global fashion after joining the WTO, but also embodied the shifting values of the post-80s and post-90s generation in their pursuit of self-expression.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Abundance, ambition, individual expression, confidence, optimism

fashion.Women's Fashion: Palette: Bright pink, yellow, denim blue, black and white.
fashion.Tops: Oversized T-shirts (Metersbonwe/Semir); polo shirts,; casual shirts with chest embroidery; hooded sweatshirts
fashion.Bottoms: Straight-leg jeans; cargo pants; sweatpants; ripped jeans with silver trouser chains
fashion.Shoes: Converse canvas sneakers; Vans skate shoes; sports shoes; the "dirty shoe trend" is in vogue
fashion.Accessories: Baseball caps; cross necklaces; metallic bracelets
